prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1183; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported right knee pain with difficulty bearing weight. Over the course of nineteen visits, care consisted of physical examination, imaging review, a structured rehabilitation program, and activity modification. The patient followed the recommended plan consistently, and treatment intensity was gradually reduced as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Several examination findings, including localized tenderness and a positive effusion sign, are consistent with a soft tissue knee injury. Other orthopedic and ligamentous tests were within normal limits. No prior complaints or treatment involving the same knee were reported or identified in the available history. Billing records reflect the services rendered without duplicate or repeated charges for the same procedures. Given the low-speed nature of the impact, the severity of the reported symptoms at initial presentation is noted for the reviewing team's consideration. Discharge from active care was planned once the patient reached functional goals, with home exercise instructions provided.
